```python
from fractions import Fraction
def ref_round(z, shift):
    if shift == 0: return z
    q = Fraction(z, 1 << shift)
    # nearest, ties away from zero
    floor = q.numerator // q.denominator
    frac = q - floor
    if frac > Fraction(1,2): r = floor+1
    elif frac < Fraction(1,2): r = floor
    else: r = floor+1 if q > 0 else floor  # tie away from zero
    return r
```

import json, sys, subprocess, os
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work')
import main as M

def run(doc):
    text = doc if isinstance(doc, str) else json.dumps(doc)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=text.encode(),
                      capture_output=True)
    return p

def base(cfg_over=None, model_over=None, conns=None, pkts=None):
    cfg = {
        "slots": 2, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 10**12,
        "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
        "rate_num": 1000000, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 512,
        "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512, "lanes": 2,
        "service": [1, 1], "fallback": 0,
        "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]],
    }
    model = {
        "classes": 2, "embedding_dim": 1,
        "length_embedding": [[i] for i in range(16)],
        "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
        "kernel": 1, "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]]], "conv_bias": [0], "conv_shift": [0],
        "dense_weights": [[0], [1]], "dense_bias": [0, 0],
    }
    if cfg_over: cfg.update(cfg_over)
    if model_over: model.update(model_over)
    return {"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": model,
            "connections": conns if conns is not None else [],
            "packets": pkts if pkts is not None else []}

def conn(i, slot=0, label=0, split="dev"):
    return {"id": i, "slot": slot, "label": label, "split": split}

def pkt(t, c="x", l=0, d=0):
    return {"time": t, "connection": c, "length": l, "draw": d}

fails = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name, "\n  got ", got, "\n  want", want)
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

# ---- A: idle timeout boundary (>= resets) ----
doc = base({"idle_timeout": 5},
           conns=[conn("x", 0), conn("y", 1)],
           pkts=[pkt(0, "x"), pkt(5, "x"), pkt(0, "y"), pkt(4, "y"), pkt(8, "y")])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("A generations", [p["generation"] for p in o["packets"]], [1, 2, 1, 1, 1])

# ---- B: credit boundary (credit == rate_den is enough) ----
doc = base({"rate_num": 1, "rate_den": 3, "bucket_capacity": 2, "initial_tokens": 1},
           conns=[conn("x")], pkts=[pkt(0), pkt(1), pkt(2), pkt(3)])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("B decisions", [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]], ["sent", "tokens", "tokens", "sent"])
check("B credits", [p["credit"] for p in o["packets"]], [0, 1, 2, 0])

# ---- C: draw == p -> probability ; draw == p-1 -> sent ----
doc = base({"probability": [[30000]]}, conns=[conn("x")],
           pkts=[pkt(0, "x", 0, 30000), pkt(1, "x", 0, 29999)])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("C decisions", [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]], ["probability", "sent"])

# ---- D: queue boundary (unfinished == capacity) ----
doc = base({"pending_capacity": 2, "lanes": 1, "service": [10, 10]},
           conns=[conn("x")], pkts=[pkt(0), pkt(1), pkt(2), pkt(3)])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("D decisions", [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]], ["sent", "sent", "queue", "queue"])

# ---- E: bin edges (Ti / Ci exactly on an edge) ----
doc = base({"time_edges": [0, 10], "count_edges": [0, 3],
            "probability": [[0, 1], [2, 3]]},
           conns=[conn("x")],
           pkts=[pkt(0), pkt(1), pkt(2), pkt(12), pkt(13), pkt(14), pkt(15), pkt(26),
                 pkt(27, "x", 0, 2), pkt(28, "x", 0, 2), pkt(38, "x", 0, 2),
                 pkt(39, "x", 0, 1), pkt(40, "x", 0, 1), pkt(50, "x", 0, 1)])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("E decisions", [p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]],
      ["probability", "probability", "sent", "sent", "probability", "probability",
       "sent", "sent", "probability", "probability", "probability", "probability",
       "probability", "sent"])

# ---- F: quantization clamps at 15 ----
doc = base({"len_quantum": 4, "gap_quantum": 7, "window": 1},
           conns=[conn("x")],
           pkts=[pkt(0, "x", 59), pkt(1, "x", 60, 0), pkt(100, "x", 65535, 0)])

o = json.loads(run(base()).stdout)
check("G empty", o, {"packets": [], "jobs": [], "connections": [],
                     "reports": {"dev": {"connections": 0, "confusion": [[0,0],[0,0]], "macro_f1": [0,1]},
                                 "eval": {"connections": 0, "confusion": [[0,0],[0,0]], "macro_f1": [0,1]}}})

# ---- H: macro f1 reduction ----
doc = base({"classes": 3}, None,
           conns=[conn("a", 0, 0, "dev"), conn("b", 0, 1, "dev"), conn("c", 0, 2, "dev")],
           pkts=[pkt(0, "a"), pkt(1, "b"), pkt(2, "c")])

doc["model"]["dense_bias"] = [0, 0, 0]
doc["config"]["service"] = [1, 1, 1]
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)

      "confusion": [[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]], "macro_f1": [1,1]})

print()
print("FAILURES:", fails if fails else "none")
